name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add Runway Gen-4’s 4K upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It stabilizes lighting and motion far better than EXCAVA’s current upscaler, cutting flicker and artifacts that break downstream tasks. The trade-off is higher compute cost per frame—Gen-4 runs slower than EXCAVA’s default—but the quality gain justifies it for the 0.5%+ capability bump we need.

name: Torque
text: Runway Gen-4’s 4K upscaler isn’t the bottleneck—it’s the 1080p pipeline forcing it through a 4K bottleneck that wastes compute and introduces new artifacts. The real risk is that Gen-4’s upscaling will expose EXCAVA’s existing motion interpolation weaknesses, not fix them. Test it on a 1080p-to-4K upscale with a 30fps source; if flicker persists in the output, the artifact isn’t the upscaler—it’s the source.
